page.overview:
What is Windswept Mire?

The Windswept Mire is a location in the Desert Region of Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is the only setting in Chapter 12, "Ribbit Jiggle Panic", first accessed following the events from the previous chapter in Valley Seven.

;Fen 1 Contains a Gate. There are no random encounters here.

;Fen 2 Contains a Save Crystal. There are five spots in this area where the player can be ambushed by a Flan and engage battle with them. At the northeastern end of this area is a storyline boss fight with the Golden Flan.

On the northwestern end is a Puzzle Switch that must be activated to access the Secret Fen.
